Priya (Product): Hey all — PRD + RFC for the 'Priority Routing & Fallbacks' initiative is ready for cross-org review: https://docs.redwood/intern/prd/priority-routing-v1. Asking for stakeholder signoffs by EOD Wed. Main asks: scope freeze, acceptance criteria confirmation, and rollout gating policy.
Darren (Eng): I skimmed — looks mostly CI/CD + routing policy work. Two engineering decisions open: (1) default fallback model (latency vs cost tradeoff) and (2) canary %, our infra prefers 10% not 5%. @Priya thoughts?
Priya (Product): Good call. For fallback model, product leans latency-first for enterprise customers, cost-first for self-serve. I added a routing policy matrix in the doc. Canary 10% is fine, we should add automatic rollback on quality regressions (see acceptance criteria).
Chris (Eng-ML): Related: we need an explicit eval set for regression checks. I put a short checklist in the RFC but can own building the eval harness if CS provides representative prompts. @Jules can you drop 20 example prompts by Tue?
Jules (CS): Yep, I'll pull examples from the top 3 customers asking for this flow and share in a gist by Monday. Will mark sensitive bits.
Leah (Design): Quick usability note — the routing override UI screenshot needs one more state for 'forced fallback' + explanation tooltip. Small change but important for on-call clarity.
Marta (Security): From compliance side: confirm there is an audit trail for model switches and KMS key usage when routing to private deployments. PRD says logs retained 90 days, we want 1 year for enterprise. Syncing with Priya offline.
Sam (SRE): Ops notes: plan includes autoscaling policy but missing alert thresholds for queue latency. Recommend alerts at p95>150ms and sustained backpressure for 3m. Also add runbook snippet for fallback-triggered spikes.
Priya (Product): Adding both: extend logs retention to 1y for enterprise and add SRE alert thresholds. I'll update PRD tomorrow morning.
Darren (Eng): Implementation risk note: the KV-cache invalidation when switching model variants can cause small correctness blips. We'll add a CI test to validate no mismatch on saved sessions.
Chris (Eng-ML): Can we define the acceptance criteria as a small checklist in the PRD? I'll paste a short list here and we can copy it into the doc:
```
- End-to-end correctness: no session mismatch after fallback (integration test)
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= configured SLO for target tier
- Regression gate: automated eval shows no >3% drop in top-1 accuracy on eval set
- Observability: traces and per-token cost present in Console for each route
- Rollout safety: canary 10% + automated rollback on eval/regression
```
Priya (Product): Copying that into the PRD now. Also adding a decision log entry for the fallback policy (latency-first for enterprise).
Jules (CS): Confirmed I'll deliver prompts. Also FYI a customer asked for manual override in Console; we should include a permission-check item in the RFC (only admins).
Leah (Design): Will mock the forced-fallback tooltip and admin-only UI state by Tuesday.
Marta (Security): Confirmed enterprise log retention update is fine but need a KMS key rotation note. Please add to acceptance criteria.
Priya (Product): Noted. Final ask to reviewers: leave a short emoji reaction for these three items if you approve: 1) Scope freeze (no new features in this sprint) 2) Acceptance criteria list above 3) Rollout gating policy (canary 10% + rollback). I'll take non-responses as pending. Deadline: EOD Wed.
Darren (Eng): ✅ agree with scope freeze and canary 10%.
Chris (Eng-ML): :thumbsup: on acceptance criteria, will own eval harness.
Sam (SRE): +1 for alert thresholds and runbook.
Marta (Security): +1 to 1y logs and KMS rotation note added to doc.
Jules (CS): ✅ will deliver prompts and customer examples.
console-bot: Deployment report: no changes. (bot message)
Priya (Product): Thanks — I'll update the doc and post the decision log entry once changes are in. If anyone objects to any of the marked items, reply here before the deadline.
Darren (Eng): One more tiny ask — add a rollback test in the staging pipeline to exercise model swap. Helps on-call confidence.
Priya (Product): Will do. Thanks everyone.
